title: Favor will take you places hustle can’t reach.
paragraphs:
Favor will take you places hustle can’t reach.
Because what grace opens, no amount of grind can.
Walk in faith. Rest in God’s timing. Trust that His favor will put you where your effort never could. 🙏
#GraceOverHustle

📖 Bible Verse:
Proverbs 3:4 (NIV)
“Then you will win favor and a good name in the sight of God and man.”
